discoveries.title: Eyes in the stone
discoveries.seen: A row of carved skulls stands above the shin bones. Their eye sockets are deeply recessed.
discoveries.earned_by: inspect skull-altar while it is closed and the passage is not yet known

discoveries.title: Alinardo’s recollection
discoveries.seen: Alinardo recalls a way beneath the church: press the eyes of the fourth skull from the right.
discoveries.reading: The old monk’s instruction makes the carved altar worth returning to.

discoveries.title: The way under the altar
discoveries.seen: The altar turned on its pivot, and you went down the damp steps behind it into the dark.
discoveries.reading: A passage runs from the church down among the bones — toward the Aedificium.
